issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-app-fixture blocks on read in non-interactive harness
issues.problem: tui-demo.sh uses blocking read -r; ux-harness subprocess times out after 30s with uncaught TimeoutExpired
evidence: python3 ux-harness/run_audit.py --target tui-app-fixture --mode ux — TimeoutExpired stack trace
Piped stdin (printf '\n\n') exits 0 in <50ms — harness does not pipe input
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — catch TimeoutExpired; record status=fail
[ ] File: ux-harness/fixtures/tui-demo.sh — LI_TUI_HARNESS=1 non-interactive mode or stdin pipe
[ ] Test: run_audit.py --target tui-app-fixture --mode ux completes without crash
[ ] Acceptance: key_nav_help journey steps recorded in ux-audit.json

issues.title: [ux-audit] TUI adapter does not execute journey steps (key_nav_help)

adapters/tui.py run_tui_ux — no journey step execution
remediation_checklist: [ ] File: ux-harness/adapters/tui.py — execute journey steps via stdin/PTY

[ ] Test: cli_to_tui and key_nav_help journeys completed=true
